scoring: Own/donor three actions are taken from the same state, separately for each layout. Strict criterion requires all six own-law-signed symmetrized margins > .05. Selection ranks calibration single-row loss of actual own-layout joint accuracy, breaking exact ties by receiver index. Holdout controls exclude nominated rows and minimize squared relative weight/bias L1 and topology mismatch; no probe outcome enters matching. All orders, laws and orientation decisions stay paired within geometry.
graft: Transplant receiver row of weights, bias and present bits from opposite-law full history. Keep recipient h and traces. An arbitrary row transplant can change strong connectivity; report the violation rate without filtering these trials. Grouped dose differences are descriptive.
posthoc_dose_overlap: Holdout geometry/order pairs need no support-bit change in either arm and absolute weight and bias L1 mismatch at most 10% of target plus calibration scale. Reweight within each birth to its eligible pairs. If any birth has zero overlap, retain all reported counts and give no cohort estimate.
